correctness.rationale: Reconstructed spherical tip normals: simultaneous hits are twelve cross-family equal-radius spherical lenses. Pair-center distance arccos(1/3) gives zero r>=sqrt3, same-family separation arccos(-1/3) gives no overlaps at r>=sqrt(3/2); hence 12 lens areas/4pi. Spherical Gauss--Bonnet supplies L=2pi-2eta-4 cos(alpha) beta. Independently evaluated positive probabilities 0.6015098891 at r=1.25, 0.1236287046 at 1.5, 0.0047279827 at 1.7. Parabolic tangency local area scales as (sqrt3-r)^(3/2). Tetrahedral covering radius gives p=1 for 1<r<=3/(2sqrt2); bounds only in unevaluated middle region.
